Name: Automatic Friend Relationship Tags
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]This simple mod shows your level of friendship with a particular NPC as a short written tag below their name in the social menu. The levels are as such:

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]0 hearts:[/b] stranger[/size]
[*][size=3][b]1-2 hearts:[/b] acquaintance[/size]
[*][size=3][b]3-5 hearts:[/b] friend[/size]
[*][size=3][b]6-7 hearts:[/b] good friend[/size]
[*][size=3][b]8-9 hearts:[/b] close friend[/size]
[*][size=3][b]10 hearts[/b]: best friend[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Note that friendship tags do not update immediately after a friendship increase from gifting or an event - you'll need to change locations for it to show your new friendship level. The friendship tag will override the "(single)" tag for romanceable NPCs if you've met them, but will not override the partner/spouse tags for an NPC you are dating or married to or any custom tags handled by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url]﻿.

If you prefer your own custom tag for a particular character, player-set tags from NPC Relationship Tags will take priority over Automatic Friend Relationship Tags.

[/size][size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40276]NPC Relationship Tags[/url]﻿ by mushymato![/size][size=3][size=3]

[/size][/size][size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size][size=3][size=3]

Automatic Friend Relationship Tags has one config option: "'Best Friend' At 8 Hearts for Romanceables". If set to true, romanceable characters will have a shortened list of friend levels which tags them as 'best friend' at 8 hearts instead of 10, so that dating is not required. If set to 'false', romanceable characters will instead be tagged as 'close friend' at 8 hearts like non-romanceable characters.

If [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4668]Platonic Relationships [/url]﻿is installed, this option is automatically set to false for compatibility.
[/size][/size][size=3][size=3]
[/size][/size][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][size=3][size=3]

Automatic Friend Relationship Tags is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40810]Automatic In-Law Relationship Tags[/url], Platonic Partners and Friendships, Platonic Relationships, and the following custom NPCs:

[/size][/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village [/url]﻿(and all add-on NPCs)[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31888]Dead Boy Detectives[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts & Jean[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10671]Alecto the Witch[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17309]Casper and the Box[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17660]Honeyfuggle the Whimsical Wanderer[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6307]Lucikiel[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33082]Once Upon a Fleurine[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38698]Pelican Town Municipal[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14158]Sydney[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16326]The Fishmonger[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][i]Why these NPCs? Why not SVE?

[/i]Because I wanted to cover these NPCs. I don't offer SVE compatibility.[/size][size=5][b]

Permissions[/b][/size][size=3]

If you would like to translate this mod, you may as long as AI is not used for the translation and only the translated i18n file is uploaded.

If you would like to use my code to create a version of this mod for other custom NPCs, you may as long as I am credited and there is a link back to this mod.[/size]
